Inner Scroller

Retrieval augmented generation grounds model output in verifiable sources before answering (section 1).

Chunking strategy decides how much context each passage carries and both extremes hurt (section 2).

Embedding models compress text into dense vectors whose distances approximate similarity (section 3).

Hybrid search blends lexical matching with vector similarity so identifiers still match (section 4).

Reranking scores a shortlist of candidates against the query and is slower but sharper (section 5).

Evaluation of retrieval quality uses recall at k and mean reciprocal rank together (section 6).
